tools.name: sp_api_list_endpoints
tools.description: List all API endpoints (tables + custom RPCs). Returns endpoint name, HTTP method, URI, table, and supported actions. Supports substring search.

search.description: Filter endpoints by name, table, or URI (case-insensitive substring match)

tools.name: sp_api_get_endpoint
tools.description: Get full schema for a single endpoint: fields, filters, sorts, includes, relationships, validation rules, and auth requirements. Check includes[].writable/payloadHint before writing related data — relationships marked writable:true can be nested in the SAME create/update payload (one request) instead of a separate request per child table.

actions.description: Return only these actions (for example ["list", "create"]); omit to get every action. Fields, filters and includes are always returned.

tools.name: sp_api_list_permissions
tools.description: List all available permissions grouped by resource.

tools.name: sp_api_get_api_guidance
tools.description: Explain the Data MCP and Schema MCP roles, then guide an agent through discovering and safely calling a documented API endpoint.
